metadata.title: Micron Stock: Amid the Gloom, 1 Big Catalyst Shines Bright Ahead of Earnings<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Dell Called Out the Memory Chip Shortage. Micron Stock Shrugs.
It’s been a tough few months for Micron Technology stock but that doesn’t mean the memory-chip boom is waning. All the signs are that shortages are only getting worse ahead of Micron’s earnings later this month which is the next big hope in terms of lifting the shares.
